node.statement: Elementary uniform defect ledger: at a fixed matrix level T is UCP, hence ||T||<=1 and T(U^*)=T(U)^*, while D=T^2-T has ||D||<=eta. Thus ||T^2(U)-T(U)||<=eta||U|| and, by inserting T(U)T^2(V), ||T^2(U)T^2(V)-T(U)T(V)||<=2eta||U||||V||. Consequently G_X=T^2(T(X^*)T(X))-T(T^2(X^*)T^2(X)) has ||G_X||<=3eta||X||^2. These estimates use no dimension, trace, Kraus sum, or ancillary basis.
